title: Wood Twigs 16x
description: Turns wood buttons into little twigs!
body:
**This is the 16x version of Wood Twigs. The 32x version can be found on my profile or [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/wood-twigs-32x) :)**

<hr>

This texture pack changes the model and texture of the all wood buttons to resemble little piles of twigs when placed.

I think this pack allows a bit more detail to be put into environmental builds such as gardens or paths, as well as forested areas, all while retaining a vanilla feel!

<hr>

The twigs also rotate randomly to add even more variety to your builds!

They are also able to be placed on walls and ceilings to add more detail to trees!
